title: One San José apartment, 62 new medical-billing companies in six months

beats.text: This is one apartment in San José.
From May to November 2026, how many new medical companies used this address?

visual.label: May to November 2026
visual.sub: new medical companies giving this address

visual.label: companies, one San José address
visual.sub: 58 of them naming Apt A2 · 46 equipment suppliers, 16 clinical labs

beats.text: This is a lead, not a finding.

visual.line: This is a lead, not a finding: a pattern in public records. This film says what the records show, what they do not show, and what would settle it.

beats.text: How is that possible? To bill Medicare or Medi-Cal, a provider needs an identifier.

steps.name: A provider number
steps.sub: needed to bill Medicare or Medi-Cal

beats.text: It’s free, takes minutes online, and nobody inspects the address.

steps.name: A provider number
steps.sub: needed to bill Medicare or Medi-Cal

beats.text: 46 say they supply medical equipment. 16 say they’re clinical labs.
Both need warehouses, instruments and licences.

visual.line: Dozens cannot operate from one apartment

beats.text: An address like this usually exists to receive mail and pass an address check.

visual.line: Dozens cannot operate from one apartment

beats.text: They came in bursts. 24 in July alone. 17 in September.

visual.label: New provider numbers at the apartment, 2026

beats.text: Batches suggest one operator making many shells, so when one is shut down, others remain.
Now the names. Arcline Billing Group. Axiora Healthcare Billing. ClaimNest Solutions.
They sound like billing services. But they’re registered to sell equipment or lab tests.

visual.line: names equipment suppliers, with home health agencies, as a long-standing program-integrity threat

beats.text: Federal Medicare officials call equipment suppliers a long-standing fraud risk.

visual.line: names equipment suppliers, with home health agencies, as a long-standing program-integrity threat

beats.text: Since February 2026, a federal moratorium has barred new ones from enrolling.

visual.label: Nationwide moratorium
visual.sub: no new Medicare equipment suppliers since 27 February 2026

beats.text: All 46 came after.

visual.label: Nationwide moratorium
visual.sub: no new Medicare equipment suppliers since 27 February 2026

beats.text: Then an apartment in Santa Clara.
How many labs were registered there in one day?
Seven.

beats.text: A clinical lab needs a federal certificate and a state licence, tied to a physical lab.

beats.text: And four equipment suppliers give an apartment in Newark as their mailing address.
An identifier is not a claim.
